fact: A national program managed by the Rwanda Space Agency will use Planet's near-daily satellite data to monitor agriculture and food security, as announced by Planet and the Government of Rwanda.

The Rwanda Space Agency's GeoHub, supported by an AFD-backed project, uses satellite images to support sectors including agriculture, and geospatial data is already used to build climate projections informing agriculture and food security policy, per the interweave newsletter.
